title: A non-restaurant business sent to POST /v1/demos is built for its own trade, not as a restaurant
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/wo-public-demos.test.mjs — POST /v1/demos with category fitness, Beauty, Vietnamese, pizza and an unknown word; read wo_opportunity.candidate.trade, then revisionForAction's brief
expect: S1: fitness and beauty keep their trade in the candidate and the brief, with no menu page and no 'dishes' in missing; Vietnamese and pizza become food; an unknown word becomes other
evidence: origin/develop 5b3b52f994: importSnapshot wrote candidate.category but no trade, so buildBrief defaulted to food
fence: unrecognised text is never read as food
